text_block_list.text:
One day, I happen upon Rice Shower<n>outside the
academy gates. Curious, I<n>ask where she's
headed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm, I'm going out to buy a picture<n>book.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I find myself wondering what kind of<n>picture books
Rice Shower normally<n>reads.
choice_data_list: Do you mind if I tag along?

text_block_list.text: You want to come with me? I'd love<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having given me the green light, we<n>head out
together.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:

the picture book is sold<n>out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I always feel so calm when I<n>read them...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Through those pages, I can explore<n>different worlds
and learn so many<n>wonderful things...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower

That's why I get so excited when I<n>find a new one
to read!

text_block_list.text:

we can think of.<n>Then, just as the sun begins to
set...

text_block_list.text: Oh! Big Brother! Here it is! This is the<n>book!

text_block_list.text: Huh? R-reserving a copy? I wonder...
